messages.text: wHAT IS THE HeliumDeploy App?
Handed to the team · No information on a HeliumDeploy app in my product facts.

I don't want to guess on that one — the team has it and will confirm by email, today from 10am ET.

Meanwhile, on the page you're on: the trio pack is three DC06 scrypt miners for $760, one of them free. Are you looking at it for DOGE/LTC alongside your BC04 order, or as a standalone setup?
I am looking at expanding my scrypt miners
Searched the catalog · Hammer DC06 scrypt miner doge bundle

Then the trio pack is the best value on the shelf: 3 DC06, $760, 990 MH/s combined at about 315W. That's roughly $0.77 per MH/s, better than the DC06+DC08 duo at $799.99 for 810 MH/s. Fair warning, DC06 is final sale, no returns.

What do you pay per kWh? 315W works out to about $23 a month at 10¢.
Yes, I know, that is why I am looking, but I keep seeing free access to the HeliumDeploy App, but I have never been invited.

That's a fair gripe — it's listed as included on every DC06 and bundle, and you've bought from us. I don't want to invent how access is handed out, so that's exactly what I flagged. The team picks it up today at 10am ET and sends the answer to your email.

Does that hold up the trio pack, or do you want it either way?
Just ordered the t40, so looking to see what is out there, for my next upgrade.

Nice, the 40T covers your Bitcoin side, so the scrypt bench is the right next move.

Best value there is still the trio pack: 990 MH/s for $760, versus $539 for a single DC08 at 480 MH/s. Three machines means three independent shots at a Doge block instead of one.

Want me to build the trio cart?
May I order parts?
Searched the catalog · power supply replacement parts accessories spare PSU cable k

Two parts listings are live: the Power Kit at $69.99 (plug-in energy monitor plus an AC cable, pick US/EU/UK to match your address) and the Overclocking kit at $59.99, which is really a Meanwell 12V 29A supply, nine heatsinks and thermal paste. Fair warning, overclocking voids the warranty.

Which part are you after, a spare PSU or something else?
I need a power supply for my bitaxe 602?

I don't want to guess the voltage and amperage on a Bitaxe 602 and sell you the wrong brick — the only standalone supply we list is the Meanwell 12V 29A in that $59.99 kit, which isn't a Bitaxe match.

Let me get that checked properly.
Handed to the team · Need the correct PSU spec for a Bitaxe 602; no matching standalone PSU in the ca

The team has it and will confirm the right supply by email — they pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET.

Meanwhile, do you want the trio pack held in a cart so it's ready, or are you waiting on the PSU answer first?
waiting for the answer.
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: what made you order the 40T over adding more scrypt first?
How about a new housing for a 601?
Searched the catalog · bitaxe case housing enclosure shell frame

No standalone housing or stand in the catalog — the 3D-printed stand only comes in the box with a unit.

Useful one though: our Gamma 602 listing ships with a MEANWELL 5V 10A (LRS-50-5), so that's the supply spec on that board. I'll have the team confirm it fits yours.
Yes, that is perfect for my needs.

Good. The team will confirm the PSU and the app access by email tomorrow from 10am ET.

The trio pack is there whenever you want it — $760, 990 MH/s, and I can build the cart in one line.
still comparing about the trio.

Straight comparison: trio is $0.77 per MH/s, the duo $0.99, a lone DC08 $1.12. Trio wins on price and gives three separate block shots.

The honest catch: DC08 is the more efficient board, 480 MH/s on 137W, and it's returnable. DC06 is final sale.

Cheapest hashrate or best efficiency — which matters more to you?
